descriptionChirho: The two-word compound proper name 'Pharaoh Necho' (par'oh nekho), referring to Pharaoh Necho II of Egypt's 26th dynasty, who figures prominently in the accounts of Josiah's death and Jehoiakim's installation (2 Kgs 23:29-35, 2 Chr 35:20-36:4, Jer 46:2). S128665 supplies the personal name element 'Necho/Neko' while S128666 supplies the title element 'Pharaoh'. These are not two different senses but two lexical components of a single compound designation. Multilingual evidence: eng 'Pharaoh Neko', spa 'Faraon Neco', hin फ़रोह नखोह, arb فِرْعَوْن نَخُو, kor 파라오 느고, swa 'Farao Neko'.
